titulo: Cop31 live: ‘No one is coming to rescue us,’ Greta Thunberg tells climate summit
cuerpo: World leaders including UK prime minister Andy Burnham are addressing the summit today, as talks head into the third day Zack Polanski , leader of the Green party in the UK, criticised Andy Burnham’s Cop31 speech on Radio 4’s Today programme. Saying he was “not at all reassured” by the prime minister’s words, he described it as a “bizarre” speech. Polanski said climate action is about what you do, not what you say, referring to the recent decision by the energy secretary, Miatta Fahnbulleh , to allow drilling in the Jackdaw gasfield in the North Sea. It’s “one step forwards, two steps back”, Polanski said. Continue reading...
